implementation: naome-validator start directly dispatches canonical state execution.
naome-verifier verify performs portable read-only full-finality and mathematical archive replay.
Archive reads reject oversized, symlink/reparse and nonregular inputs; Unix FIFO and Windows device inputs are rejected before blocking reads.
Canonical process suite uses actual naome-validator and naome-verifier siblings; no fallback.
SIGKILL recovery observes byte-identical network vote retransmission without a new proposal, rejects conflicting signing, catches up exact finality frames and supplies a necessary next-quorum vote.
Authenticated historical conflict persists a signer halt; startup rollback, missing, corrupt and foreign authority inputs fail without rewriting files.
Legacy Byzantine process fixture now uses the existing process isolation guard.
